name: MONITORAMENTO DE PREÇO — V3 SEGURO (confirmação rígida)

parameters.query:
SELECT
  o.id AS offer_id,
  o.product_id,
  o.external_product_id,
  p.title AS product_title,
  o.public_url,
  o.current_price,
  o.original_price,
  o.discount_percent
FROM public.offers o
JOIN public.products p ON p.id = o.product_id
WHERE o.is_published = true
  AND o.availability_status = 'available'
  AND o.public_url ILIKE '%mercadolivre.com%'
ORDER BY o.last_checked_at ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 15

=WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE public.offers
  SET current_price = {{ $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.precoNovo }},
      original_price = {{ $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.precoOriginalNovo === null ? 'NULL' : $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.precoOriginalNovo }},
      discount_percent = {{ $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.discountPercentNovo }},
      availability_status = 'available',
      last_checked_at = now(),
      last_check_status = 'ok',
      last_check_error = NULL,
      consecutive_check_failures = 0
  WHERE id = '{{ $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.offer_id }}'
  RETURNING id
), logged AS (
  INSERT INTO public.offer_monitoring_logs (offer_id, outcome, product_title, page_title, public_url, stored_current_price, detected_current_price, detected_original_price, price_source, parser_version, reason, http_status)
  SELECT '{{ $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.offer_id }}', 'updated',
    '{{ String($('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.productTitle || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ String($('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.pageTitle || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ String($('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.public_url || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    {{ $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.precoAntigo }}, {{ $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.precoNovo }},
    {{ $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.precoOriginalNovo === null ? 'NULL' : $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.precoOriginalNovo }},
    '{{ String($('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.priceSource || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', 'n8n-v3-seguro', NULL,
    {{ $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.httpStatus || 200 }}
  FROM updated
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT updated.id, 'updated'::text AS outcome FROM updated;

=INSERT INTO public.price_history (offer_id, price, original_price, recorded_at, source)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.offer_id }}',
  {{ $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.precoNovo }},
  {{ $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.precoOriginalNovo === null ? 'NULL' : $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.precoOriginalNovo }},
  now(),
  'automacao-n8n-v3'
)
RETURNING id;

=WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE public.offers
  SET last_checked_at = now(), last_check_status = 'ok', last_check_error = NULL, consecutive_check_failures = 0
  WHERE id = '{{ $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.offer_id }}'
  RETURNING id
), logged AS (
  INSERT INTO public.offer_monitoring_logs (offer_id, outcome, product_title, page_title, public_url, stored_current_price, detected_current_price, price_source, parser_version, reason, http_status)
  SELECT '{{ $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.offer_id }}', 'unchanged',
    '{{ String($('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.productTitle || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ String($('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.pageTitle || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ String($('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.public_url || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    {{ $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.precoAntigo }}, {{ $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.precoNovo }},
    '{{ String($('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.priceSource || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', 'n8n-v3-seguro', NULL,
    {{ $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.httpStatus || 200 }}
  FROM updated
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT updated.id, 'unchanged'::text AS outcome FROM updated;

=WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE public.offers
  SET availability_status = 'unavailable', last_checked_at = now(), last_check_status = 'unavailable',
      last_check_error = 'Produto indisponível na página monitorada', consecutive_check_failures = 0
  WHERE id = '{{ $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.offer_id }}'
  RETURNING id
), logged AS (
  INSERT INTO public.offer_monitoring_logs (offer_id, outcome, product_title, page_title, public_url, stored_current_price, parser_version, reason, http_status)
  SELECT '{{ $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.offer_id }}', 'unavailable',
    '{{ String($('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.productTitle || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ String($('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.pageTitle || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ String($('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.public_url || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    {{ $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.precoAntigo }}, 'n8n-v3-seguro',
    '{{ String($('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.motivo || 'Produto indisponível').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    {{ $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.httpStatus || 200 }}
  FROM updated
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT updated.id, 'unavailable'::text AS outcome FROM updated;

=WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE public.offers
  SET last_checked_at = now(),
      last_check_status = CASE WHEN '{{ $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.outcome }}' = 'revisao_manual' THEN 'review' ELSE 'error' END,
      last_check_error = '{{ String($('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.motivo || 'Falha temporária').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
      consecutive_check_failures = coalesce(consecutive_check_failures, 0) + 1
  WHERE id = '{{ $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.offer_id }}'
  RETURNING id
), logged AS (
  INSERT INTO public.offer_monitoring_logs (offer_id, outcome, product_title, page_title, public_url, stored_current_price, detected_current_price, price_source, parser_version, reason, http_status)
  SELECT '{{ $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.offer_id }}',
    '{{ String($('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.outcome || 'error').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ String($('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.productTitle || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ String($('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.pageTitle || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ String($('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.public_url || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    {{ $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.precoAntigo }},
    {{ $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.detectedCurrentPrice === undefined ? 'NULL' : $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.detectedCurrentPrice }},
    '{{ String($('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.priceSource || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', 'n8n-v3-seguro',
    '{{ String($('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.motivo || 'Falha temporária').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    {{ $('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.httpStatus || 200 }}
  FROM updated
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT updated.id, '{{ String($('PROCESSA RESPOSTA').item.json.outcome || 'error').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text AS outcome FROM updated;
